dedupe_keys.name: room level occupant counts and environmental quality in a smart building sdu denmark

description: A dataset of room-level occupant counts together with indoor environmental quality readings from a public building in Northern Europe, produced at the University of Southern Denmark and described in a 2019 Scientific Data descriptor. It covers 44 full days between March 2018 and April 2019 and three rooms: one lecture room and two study zones. Two versions are released, the raw sensor readings and a version upsampled to one-minute resolution; the upsampled version holds 67,680 readings per stream. Each sensor modality in each room has its own CSV file, with metadata columns, and coverage differs by sensor because dynamic and static sampling rates were used; the authors note that the illuminance stream has low coverage. The data are hosted on figshare and the pre-processing code, which handles suppression and data processing, is on GitHub. Licence: the article is CC BY 4.0; cost is free. Caveats: three rooms in one building is a small sample. The authors intend it for developing and benchmarking occupant sensing, occupancy modelling and building analytics, and it can feed agent-based occupant models and ventilation or space capacity planning studies; related records are not yet linked.
